question: If (p)/(q)=0.5, then (3 p-q)/(3 p+q) is:
solution:
**Given:**

p/q = 0.5

**Formula used:**

(3p - q) / (3p + q)

**Calculation:**

p/q = 0.5

⇒ p = 0.5q

(3p - q) / (3p + q)

⇒ (3(0.5q) - q) / (3(0.5q) + q)

⇒ (1.5q - q) / (1.5q + q)

⇒ 0.5q / 2.5q

⇒ 0.5 / 2.5

⇒ 1 / 5

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
